test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In September 2025, which region planned to establish a dedicated women police station in each district for enhanced safety?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Each of Delhi’s 15 Districts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Delhi Government** announced the establishment of **dedicated women police stations** in all **15 districts** of Delhi to enhance the safety and security of women.
 
• The initiative aims to address the increasing concerns of **women’s safety** in the capital city by providing a specialized and accessible platform for women to report crimes.
 
• Each of the 15 districts will have its own dedicated women police station, ensuring that **women-centric cases** such as domestic violence, sexual assault, and harassment are handled with sensitivity and professionalism.
 
• This decision is a significant step toward **gender-sensitive policing** and aims to build trust between women citizens and law enforcement agencies.
 
• With this initiative, the government aims to **increase the reporting of gender-based crimes** and ensure faster resolution by deploying trained women officers in these police stations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Women Police Stations:**

 
 
• Women police stations are specialized units that exclusively deal with **women-related crimes** such as domestic violence, dowry harassment, eve-teasing, and sexual assault.
 
• These stations are staffed primarily by women officers trained to handle sensitive cases with **empathy and professionalism**.
 
• Such police stations aim to create a **safe and welcoming environment** for women to report crimes without fear of judgment or reprisal.
 
 
 
• **Women’s Safety in Delhi:**
 
 
• Delhi has been a focal point for addressing **women’s safety concerns**, especially after the infamous Nirbhaya case in 2012, which led to nationwide protests and demands for stricter laws.
 
• The city has seen initiatives like **enhanced patrolling, installation of CCTV cameras, and deployment of women officers** to ensure safety in public spaces.
 
 
 
• **Similar Initiatives in Other States:**
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:** The state has launched various women-centric initiatives, such as **Pink Patrol units** and women help desks, to address crimes against women.
 
• **West Bengal:** The government has set up women police stations across districts to ensure **gender-sensitive policing**.
 
 
 
• **Key Legal Framework for Women’s Safety:**
 
 
• **Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013:** This act introduced stricter punishments for sexual offenses and new offenses like stalking and voyeurism.
 
• **Domestic Violence Act, 2005:** Provides protection to women against domestic violence and ensures their right to live in a **violence-free environment**.
 
• **Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013:** Ensures protection against harassment at the workplace.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Women Help Desks:** Many police stations across India now have **women help desks** to provide immediate assistance to women in distress.
 
• **One Stop Centres:** These centers, introduced under the **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign**, provide medical, legal, and psychological support to women facing violence.
 
• **Nirbhaya Fund:** Launched by the Indian government to **support initiatives** that enhance the safety and security of women.
